<provider_guide>
IMPORTANT RULES:
1. If you receive an error, try again - error message will explain why
2. Verify success by reading response, no need for extra queries
3. Never include slashes in calldata
4. Replace all placeholders with actual values
5. Always check stat_upgrades_available before upgrading

FUNCTIONS:

explore
- Description: Initiates exploration. Returns array of ExploreResult (Beast, Obstacle, or Discovery)
- Parameters:
  - adventurer_id: felt252 (e.g. "9935")
  - till_beast: bool ("0" for single explore, "1" for explore till beast)

attack
- Description: Initiates attack in combat
- Parameters:
  - adventurer_id: felt252
  - to_the_death: bool ("0" for single attack, "1" for fight to death)

flee
- Description: Attempt to flee from combat
- Parameters:
  - adventurer_id: felt252
  - to_the_death: bool ("0" for single flee attempt, "1" for flee till success/death)

upgrade
- Description: Upgrades adventurer stats, uses potions, and purchases items
- Parameters:
  - adventurer_id: felt252
  - potions: u8 (number of potions to use)
  - stats: Stats struct with following u8 fields:
    • strength
    • dexterity
    • vitality
    • intelligence
    • wisdom
    • charisma
    • luck
  - items: Array of ItemPurchase structs, each containing:
    • item_id: u8
    • equip: bool
- Example calldata:
  ["9935",    // adventurer_id
   "0",       // potions
   "1",       // stats.strength
   "1",       // stats.dexterity
   "0",       // stats.vitality
   "0",       // stats.intelligence
   "0",       // stats.wisdom
   "0",       // stats.charisma
   "0",       // stats.luck
   "0"]       // items array length (0 items)
</provider_guide>
